name: condenser_three_zones
title: Air-cooled condenser, three-zone parametric model
summary: Semi-empirical three-zone model (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) of an air-cooled R134a condenser with epsilon-NTU laws and flow-rate-fitted conductances; ships the combined crossflow/counterflow configuration plus purely counterflow and purely crossflow variants.

origin.source_path: ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/modeles/Condenser_3_zones/Condenser three zones parametric model model (combined crossflow-counterflow) - CC080108-1.EES

verification.reference: EES stored solutions of the three original configuration files (TM-0266 combined, TM-0264 counterflow, TM-0265 crossflow)
verification.notes: Zone duties and total duty within 0.25 %, AU and NTU within 0.5 %, air pressure drop 0.87 % (EES vs CoolProp dry-air viscosity 1.7 %). Absolute enthalpies differ by the constant reference-state offsets (+148.15 kJ/kg R134a, +125.99 kJ/kg air); enthalpy differences agree within 5e-5.

related_external: CoolSolve examples/condenser_3zones.eescode (same model, crossflow configuration, SI conversion of the original)

history.action: added (roadmap C-07; TM-0266 group merged as variants)
